meaning: Bubble error: oversudsing was detected, and the dishwasher stops to prevent leaks.
diySteps: Do not use dish soap; use a small amount of liquid dishwasher detergent, or preferably powder or solid detergent made for dishwashers
To confirm oversudsing, run the dishwasher empty with no detergent; if suds and bE appear, the cause is improper detergent

To clear suds: set the rinse aid level to L0, add no detergent, put a bowl with 200 ml (7 oz) of milk in the middle of the upper rack, and run the Standard cycle with the Extra Dry and Rinse options. Repeat if suds remain, then restore your rinse aid level
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If bE appears without any suds, LG says to request service.
sourceTitle: [LG Dishwasher] Guide to Error Codes (LG USA Support)
